mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 4.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening housing market, which reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST decline for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 5.0%) and aggressive tightening (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy response reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates weakening economic activity, which reduces corporate earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly change in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) falls below 50,000 jobs, it signals a slowing labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS < 50,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a contraction in the housing sector that dampens consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST decline for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and high job growth (PAYEMS > 100,000), the labor market overheating triggers inflationary pressures and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
